extraDisciplines: static-site-only: this is a hand-written HTML/CSS/JS site with a self-contained WebGL2 mesh — no bundler, no WASM, no compile. Hypotheses must respect that; do not propose introducing a build framework.

browser-checks-out-of-annexe: accessibility, performance (Lighthouse), and playwright visual tests need the browsercontainer sidecar, which the HP annexe does NOT have. Never invent a browser evaluator here — record such findings as 'HANDOFF (browser):' notes for a sidecar-equipped run (npm run test:a11y / test:perf locally).
content-is-the-product: copy, messaging, and asset integrity are the surfaces that matter for a marketing site — weight them above code-structure concerns.
